requested_service.diagnosis: Low Back Pain with Lumbar Radiculopathy

clinical_documents.content: Patient reports persistent low back pain with radiating pain into the left leg. Symptoms continue to limit normal daily activities despite conservative management.
Patient completed six weeks of supervised physical therapy for low back pain. Symptoms and functional limitations persist despite treatment.
Lumbar spine MRI without contrast requested for further evaluation of persistent lumbar radicular symptoms following conservative treatment.
